becomeAffiliate.heading: Yiba Umhlanganyeli
becomeAffiliate.description: Zuza ikhomishini ekuqashiseni nasekuthengisweni okuqediwe okudlulise kona, kuphela ezintweni ohlwini umthengisi azivumele ngokukhethekile. Ukushintshanisa akusoze kuzuze ikhomishini.

affiliateProgram.heading: Uhlelo Lomhlanganyeli
affiliateProgram.codeNotice: Phequlula izinto ohlwini ezivumela abahlanganyeli ngezansi bese ukopisha isixhumanisi sakho sokwabelana — ikhomishini itholwa kuphela ezintweni ohlwini umthengisi aziyivumele, futhi akusoze kwenzeke ekushintshaniseni.
affiliateProgram.noEnabledListings: Azikho izinto ohlwini okwamanje ezivumela abahlanganyeli.
affiliateProgram.footerNotice: Amakhomishini acutshungulwa ngokuzenzakalela ngemuva kwesikhathi esifushane sokubuyekeza.

affiliateManagement.heading: Abahlanganyeli
affiliateManagement.infoNotice: Vumela abahlanganyeli ngokwento ngayinye ohlwini ngezansi. Ikhomishini ikhokhiswa kuphela ekuthengisweni noma ezinkokhelweni zokuqashisa ezifanelekile ezaqediwe — akusoze kwenzeke kuzibambiso, izimbuyiselo, noma ukushintshaniswa. Izinkokhelo zabahlanganyeli ziphathwa ngokuzenzakalela yi-Unity egameni lakho.
affiliateManagement.footerNotice: Izinga lekhomishini leyunithi ngayinye ohlwini lisethwa kusihleli sohlu.
affiliateManagement.errorToggle: Ayikwazanga ukubuyekeza isilungiselelo sabahlanganyeli salolu hlu

rtbTerms.heading: Imigomo Yokuqasha-Ukuze-Uthenge
rtbTerms.ownershipNotice: Uhlala ungumnikazi wento kuze kube yilapho umthengi eseqedile inqubo yonke yokudluliswa kobunikazi engezansi — ukuba nento nobunikazi bayo kuhlukene.
rtbTerms.securityDeposit: Isibambiso sokuphepha (ZAR, kungakhethwa — akusoze sibalwe entengweni)
rtbTerms.allowEarlyPayoff: Vumela ikhasimende likhokhe imali esele ngaphambi kwesikhathi
rtbTerms.allowCure: Vumela ikhasimende ukulungisa ukwehluleka nokuqhubeka nesivumelwano
rtbTerms.securityDepositNotice: Igcinwa ehlukile enanini lokuthenga. Iyabuyiselwa lapho isivumelwano siphela ngempumelelo, ngaphandle uma ilahlekile ngenxa yokubuyiselwa kwesikhathi eside okuqinisekisiwe.

trigger.fullPayment: Kuphela ngemva kokuba inani lonke likhokhiwe

rtbTerms.rentalUseNotice: Isetshenziswa kuphela uma lesi sivumelwano siphela ngaphambi kokuba ubunikazi budluliswe — i-Unity ikhokhisa ikhomishini yayo yokuqasha kuleli zinga ngesikhathi umthengi ayenayo ngempela into, hhayi enanini lokuthenga.
rtbTerms.wearDamageStandard: Izinga lokugugeka nokulimala (akudingekile — kuboniswa kumthengi ngaphambi kokuba avume)
rtbTerms.gracePeriodDays: Isikhathi esengeziwe ngaphambi kokuthi inkokhelo engakhokhwanga ifaneleke ekwehluleceni (izinsuku)
rtbTerms.escrowNotice: Izavenga zigcinwa kuze kube yilapho isivumelwano siphothulwa ngempumelelo noma sixazululwe ngemva kokwehluleka — azikhokhelwa wena ngokushesha.

pricing.subheading: Akukho mali yenyanga yokuqala. Nyusa noma nini ukuze uthole amazinga aphansi ekhomishini nezinto ohlwini ezingenamkhawulo. Ukushintshaniswa akusoze kube khona ikhomishini, kunoma yiluphi uhlelo.
